scope: All 81 whole-token nužn- necessity forms in live v019 Latin sources, plus 14 adjacent malformed potrebno/nepotrebno/trěbalo/trebalo/trěbajut tokens and seven sentence-level agreement or spelling repairs.
choice: Use the official type-1 potrěbn-/potrěbno family for nominal, predicative, and adverbial mathematical necessity; preserve logical scope in negated-necessity contexts; repair necessary-and-sufficient conditions to singular agreement where the German source has Bedingung; normalize the adjacent trěba/trěbujut family.
motivation: The official dictionary marks nužny as type 2 with Russian-oriented metadata and negative West-Slavic flags, whereas type-1 potrěbny/potrěbno has broad East, West, and South support and explicitly covers necessary/necessarily. Exact German comparison distinguishes necessary, not necessarily, and necessary-and-sufficient conditions, so a blind modal replacement was not acceptable.
alternatives_rejected: Retain nužn- as a second free family: it preserves the source-shaped layer without an intelligibility gain.
Replace ne nužno with ne trěba: that changes logical scope from not necessarily P to P is not needed.
Use neizběžno: inevitability is stronger than logical necessity.
Use morati or musěti globally: those split South- and West-Slavic preferences and would turn nominal conditions into finite modal clauses.
Blind nužn- to potrěbn- substitution: it would leave the duplicate nužno potrěbno phrase and the two singular Bedingung agreement errors.

official_dictionary.accepted_entries: id 29955 potrěbno type 1; id 1296 potrěbny type 1; id 13042 trěba type 1; id 5786 nepotrěbny; id 1942 trěbovati
official_dictionary.rejected_entry: id 28707 nužny type 2, regional metadata ru j and negative West-Slavic flags

official_verb_grammar.relevance: -ovati to -uj- present stem and third-person plural -ut, establishing trěbujut

independent_math_comparators.method: presence by independent language/body, never raw token mass
independent_math_comparators.finding: West and South sources use their native necessary-condition families; Macedonian mathematical prose directly uses potrebnite i dovolnite uslovi / potreben i dovolen uslov, while official type-1 metadata supplies the cross-family bridge

construction_corrections: The first dry run required a single-count locator for trěbajut although both reviewed occurrences share base line 9998. It failed before writing; the two exact surrounding phrases were then used as distinct locators.

The next dry run counted only lowercase trěba and reported 310 instead of the case-insensitive 364 expected forms. The transformation itself was unchanged; the postcondition was corrected to include sentence-initial Trěba before apply.

validation.coverage: 81/81 nužn- sites plus every exact adjacent malformed token and agreement phrase
validation.residue: zero nužn-, potrebno-, nepotrebno-, trebalo-, trěbalo-, and trěbajut whole-token residue
validation.dry_run_then_apply: frozen output hashes reproduced immediately before and after atomic apply
validation.structure: TeX controls, labels/references/citations, braces, math delimiters, and line counts unchanged
